title: ChapterFlow Per-Book Over-Used Material ("scars")
description: One file per book, named <bookId>.json, listing the case phrases, prop/scene frames, and free-text notes that THIS book over-uses across chapters. The section-task builder renders these only into that book's writer prompts, so one book's scar tissue never leaks into another book's universal contract. Enforcement of over-use lives in the section/book gates (SEC/AS families); these lists are writer guidance, not a gate input.

phrases.description: Verbatim case-identifying phrases this book reuses (e.g. a named-case tag). Each may appear in at most one teaching unit book-wide.

frames.description: Scene engines, prop containers, or connective frames this book defaults to across chapters and must vary instead.

notes.description: Free-text reminders specific to this book's over-use patterns.

prohibitions.description: Non-negotiable rules for this book: reader-panel safety verdicts, and fact pins where surfaces contradicted each other. Rendered in their own block, BEFORE the over-use block, as absolute rules with no quota. Never file a safety rule or fact pin under phrases/frames/notes — those render under a header granting a quota of one and instructing the writer to paraphrase the item everywhere else, which for a prohibition means restating the banned thing in different words. Optional: absent means this book has no hard rules.
